scripts.build: npm run db:switch && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://dummy:dummy@localhost:5432/dummy npx prisma generate && next build
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:switch && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:push: npm run db:switch && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:switch && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:switch && npx prisma migrate deploy
